jobs.title: HR Business Analyst till HR-systemtransformation
jobs.description:
Vi söker en erfaren HR Business Analyst till ett pågående HR\-systemtransformationsprojekt hos vår kund i Södertälje. Uppdraget är hybrid med tre dagar per vecka på plats och löper på heltid under cirka 15 månader med start snarast.
  
  

Om uppdraget
  
– Samla in, dokumentera och uppdatera business requirements för det nya HR\-systemet.
  
– Bidra till att översätta krav till processdesign, framtida processer och workflows.
  
– Stödja kravkartläggning, processanalys och impact assessments.
  
– Säkerställa att krav\- och processdokumentation är korrekt, strukturerad och aktuell.
  
– Samarbeta med projekt\- och förändringsteam för implementationsberedskap.
  
– Stödja testaktiviteter kopplade till processer och det nya systemet.
  
– Bidra till utveckling av användar\- och administratörsguider.
  
– Stödja rollout och stabiliseringsaktiviteter samt alignment av krav och processer mellan intressenter.
  
  

Vi söker dig som
  
– Har relevant akademisk utbildning eller motsvarande yrkeserfarenhet.
  
– Har erfarenhet av att arbeta med business requirements och/eller processutveckling.
  
– Förstår HR\-processer ur ett verksamhetsperspektiv.
  
– Har erfarenhet av HR\-system.
  
– Har starka dokumentationsfärdigheter och förmåga att strukturera komplex information.
  
  

Meriterande
  
– Erfarenhet av requirements mapping, processutveckling, processkartläggning och workflow design.
  
– HRBP\-erfarenhet eller kunskap om HR\-administration.
  
– Erfarenhet av HR master data, integrationer och downstream data.
  
– Erfarenhet av komplexa transformationsprogram med globala och lokala intressenter.
  
– Förmåga att skilja business requirements från solution design och teknisk implementation.
  
– Förståelse för förändringsresor och hur processdesign stödjer adoption.
  
  

Bra att veta
  
**– Ort:** Södertälje (hybrid, tre dagar per vecka på plats).
  
**– Start:** snarast.
  
**– Längd:** cirka 15 månader.
  
**– Omfattning:** 100 %.
  
**– Språk:** flytande svenska och engelska krävs.
  
  

**OBS: För att underlätta urvalet, skriv gärna i ansökan:**  

– Nuvarande ort där du bor, och om du kan pendla eller flytta
  
– Antal års relevant arbetserfarenhet
  
– Tidigaste startdatum / uppsägningstid
  
  

Skicka CV och några rader om dig till info@ndpconsult.se. Vi går igenom ansökningar löpande.
  
Ref. 16782

**Job Description:**

**The opportunity**

As a Business Intelligence Analyst within our BST GI Analytics \& Data Platform organization, you will play a pivotal role in bridging the gap between complex data and strategic action for our Grid Integration business. You will be responsible for designing and delivering customer\-driven BI applications that empower our Business unit\-wide teams to make informed decisions. By ensuring that our front\-end solutions are scalable, user\-friendly, and governed by global standards, you will contribute directly to our digital transformation journey and the ambitious goal of improving business efficiency through data transparency.


**How you’ll make an impact**

* Develop and maintain a roadmap for new, customer\-driven BI applications, ensuring that design and report interfaces meet the specific needs of our GI projects
* Ensure that all BI implementations follow the established structure and guidelines. You will drive Master Data alignment and ensure data validity through rigorous quality assurance and interface management with our data warehouse storage
* Actively identify and capture new Business Intelligence demands across the organization, translating business requirements into reusable data flow architectures
* Run BI training sessions to empower the organization, managing the application lifecycle through dedicated support, service request resolution, and the proactive use of our ticketing systems
* Ensure all initiatives follow PPS (Project Power System) process guidelines, contributing to a transparent and auditable environment that supports both internal goals and regulatory requirements

**Your background**

* Solid Experience in BI design and report development, including a deep understanding of data collection methods and interface management with data warehouse environments
* Proven ability to create and maintain reusable data flow architectures and ensure alignment with Master Data management principles
* Experience in maintaining existing BI solutions, managing application roadmaps, and utilizing ticket systems to solve service requests and issues
* Exceptional skills in identifying business demands and communicating technical structures to non\-technical stakeholders, including conducting training sessions for diverse user groups
* A firm commitment to following process guidelines (such as PPS) and ensuring that local implementations adhere to global organizational structures and BI guidelines
* Focus on data quality assurance and the ability to ensure data validity across complex, large\-scale IT initiatives

**What we offer**

* Collective agreement
* Flexible working time
* Health care and wellness allowance
* Fantastic career possibilities within Hitachi Energy both within Sweden and globally
* Mentor to support you throughout onboard phase
* Various trainings and education supporting employee development
* Diversified company with over 70\+ nationalities working in Sweden
* Supplementary compensation for parental leave
* Employee Benefit Portal with thousands of discounts and perks

jobs.title: Join Accenture as a Strategy Analyst or a Management Consulting Analyst
jobs.description:
**Do you enjoy turning ideas into action \- working with people, processes and technology to make ambitious projects succeed? Do you want to solve complex problems when there is no obvious answer \- starting with a blank piece of paper and creating clarity from ambiguity?**

  

We are looking for ambitious graduates to join Accenture in Copenhagen as Strategy Analysts or Management Consulting Analysts, starting in 2027\.

  

The work we do spans from defining strategic direction and identifying new opportunities to transform organizations and implementing new technologies. You will bring a strategic, analytical, and delivery\-oriented perspective to these multidisciplinary teams, while gaining exposure to the broader capabilities of Accenture.

  

At Accenture, we work across strategy, consulting and technology to solve our clients’ most important challenges. Our projects bring together colleagues with different backgrounds and expertise, meaning you may work alongside strategy consultants, technology specialists, data experts, and industry professionals.

**What you will do**
====================

 **Strategy Analyst**


As a Strategy Analyst, you will work with some of the largest companies and organizations in Denmark and the Nordics on the questions that shape their future. You might help a company define where to grow next, rethink its operating model, identify how AI and technology can create competitive advantage, improve profitability, or respond to major shifts in its industry.

  

Your tasks may include:

* Structuring complex and ambiguous business problems and developing clear hypotheses for how to solve them.
* Conducting market, competitor, customer and industry analyses to identify insights and opportunities.
* Building quantitative analyses, financial models, and business cases to support strategic decisions.
* Helping clients define growth strategies, transformation agendas, operating models, and strategic priorities.
* Exploring how technologies such as AI, data, and digital platforms can create new business opportunities or fundamentally change an industry.
* Preparing structured, insight\-driven presentations and recommendations for senior client stakeholders.
* Conducting interviews and workshops with clients to understand challenges, test hypotheses, and develop solutions.
* Contributing to proposals, thought leadership, and the development of new ideas for our clients.

 **Management Consulting Analyst**


As a Management Consulting Analyst, you will help some of the largest companies and organizations in Denmark and the Nordics translate ambitions and strategy into tangible change. You might help redesign operating models, improve critical business processes, introduce new technologies, support major transformations, or help teams adopt new ways of working.

  

In your daily work, you may:

* Translate strategic objectives into concrete initiatives, plans, and deliverables.
* Support the design and implementation of new processes, technologies, and ways of working.
* Coordinate activities across complex transformation programs involving multiple teams and stakeholders.
* Prepare structured presentations, analysis, project plans, and decision material.
* Plan and facilitate workshops and stakeholder interviews.
* Work closely with clients to understand requirements, resolve issues, and move implementation forward.
* Support change management activities that help organizations successfully adopt new solutions.

**The industries we work with**
===============================


Accenture works with leading organizations across a broad range of industries, including:

* Financial Services
* Consumer Goods \& Retail
* Life Sciences
* Health \& Public Services
* Resources
* Industrial \& Manufacturing
* Communications, Media \& Technology

  

**Who are we looking for?**
===========================


We are looking for candidates who are passionate about translating strategic ideas into real\-world implementation projects. There is no single background that makes a successful consultant at Accenture.


You may come from business, engineering, technology, economics, natural sciences, or another relevant field. What matters most is your ability to solve problems, collaborate with others, and turn ideas into action.

  

We are looking for candidates who:

* Hold or expect to complete a relevant master's degree by the summer of 2027\.
* Have a strong academic track record and solid analytical capabilities.
* Enjoy breaking down complex and ambiguous problems into manageable questions.
* Can bring structure to complex projects with many stakeholders and moving parts.
* Can communicate complex ideas clearly and concisely.
* Have strong quantitative and analytical capabilities.
* Are intellectually curious and enjoy learning about new businesses, industries and technologies.
* Are fluent in English and thrive in collaborative, multidisciplinary teams.

  

Many of the projects you will work on sit at the intersection of business and technology. You do not need to be a technical specialist, but you should be curious about how technology can enable better businesses and successful transformation.

**How to apply**
================


Please submit the following documents as one PDF file, in this order:

* CV
* Cover letter
* Bachelor's and master's grade transcripts

  

We kindly ask that in your cover letter, you tell us which role (Strategy or Management Consulting) you would be more interested in, and why. If you have experience or a particular interest in one of the industries in which we work, you are welcome to highlight that as well – but it is entirely optional and will not be a prerequisite for consideration.

  

Candidates are expected to start in **September 2027**. If you complete your master’s degree earlier and are available and interested in starting sooner, we will take this into consideration. Please indicate this in your application.
